tdd_result.description: Implement coalesced sync period safety ticket

data.status: implemented, tested, committed on ticket branch (merge/close left to integration per triage policy)
data.behavior_delivered: Session-commit hints now coalesce: the first hint of a turn schedules one read-only synchronization at the turn's end, same-turn hints join it, and hints arriving while that read is under way mark exactly one follow-up read after it (nothing is cleared before the promise it belongs to). The handler still settles after adoption, so close-out/disposal waits keep their meaning. Every read remains the existing synchronize: no write, lock, temp commit or re-initialization; same-period documents adopt only the disk baseline; an external period change still goes through accounting.periodSwitched(), dropping the closed period's in-flight consumption.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: multiple mergeable hints reduce syncs; final adopts independently given latest record; hints and syncs counted separately
acceptance_evidence.test: coalesced-sync-period-safety.test.ts: several notices in one turn are one synchronization...
acceptance_evidence.evidence: 3 hints -> exactly 1 storage.synchronize call (call counter on runtime.storage), all three latest file records readable via runtime.view, storage.commit/load calls 0, file bytes and root entries unchanged

acceptance_evidence.criterion: controlled pause of one sync; another real process commits and notifies; final record visible; no permanent miss
acceptance_evidence.test: coalesced-sync-period-safety.test.ts: a notice delivered while a synchronization is paused...
acceptance_evidence.evidence: real child process (tests/model-cost/support/store-child.ts, framework safe-file/lock) commits during the paused first read; second hint delivered while paused; after release exactly 2 reads occur and the child's record is visible in Owner view; file remains the child's bytes

acceptance_evidence.criterion: same-period refresh adopts disk baseline only, no commit/discard/duplicate of local in-flight
acceptance_evidence.test: coalesced-sync-period-safety.test.ts: the disk baseline is adopted while the in-flight amount stays local...
acceptance_evidence.evidence: local saved 1 + in-flight 1; external 6; after refresh own(main)=2, inclusiveTotals=8, disk record stays 1, storage.commit calls 0, file bytes unchanged

acceptance_evidence.criterion: external period switch keeps only new-period records; late hint does not bring back old accumulation
acceptance_evidence.test: coalesced-sync-period-safety.test.ts: the closed period's in-flight consumption is dropped...
acceptance_evidence.evidence: old-period in-flight 2; new document period-replaced with 3; after sync own(main)/roundTotals empty, accrued only new 3, file unchanged; late hint re-read still does not restore it; old Round end writes nothing (0 commits)

acceptance_evidence.criterion: read-only sync takes no write lock, creates no temp commit, modifies no document; missing/invalid policy reused without re-initialization
acceptance_evidence.test: read-only tests: real process reads with instrument; notice over absent/unusable document
acceptance_evidence.evidence: instrumented child FS ops {reads: 2, publishes: 0, locks: 0}, file and directory unchanged; absent root notice creates no file and keeps original period; unusable document pauses and is left untouched; storage.load calls stay 0 across all hint-driven syncs
